headline: Frontline Casualties Surge as Bases Shift
war_summary: Since the last despatch three hours ago the fighting has sharpened on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre, its two‑hour toll climbing to 809 Colonial and 798 Warden dead, a three‑fold rise from the earlier 268 and 290, while base turnover there has reached 56 changes in 24 hours. Linn Mercy has erupted, recording 367 Colonial and 519 Warden casualties in the past two hours after a modest 93 and 243 previously, and it logged 37 ownership events. Nevish Line stays fierce but its short‑term losses have eased to 592 Colonial and 1,184 Warden from 654 and 891. Mooring County holds a steady grind with 222 Colonial and 171 Warden dead. Stonecradle shows a reversal, Colonial losses up to 146 while Warden losses jump to 298. Callahans Passage continues its heavy attrition at 922 Colonial and 777 Warden. Dead Lands, quiet in the last edition, now adds 93 Colonial and 165 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow, previously dormant, has produced eleven base changes with modest losses. Enlistments are rising across all active sectors, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder, while the majority of regions report no events.
